free_tier.stated: A one-yuan one-day trial of each product, quoted 一元试用 and 我们为您提供一元试用体验保障, with a seven-day no-reason refund stated as 7天无理由, on a ladder whose lowest cloud server is advertised at CNY 15 a month and whose lowest shared host is CNY 8 a month. The operator states five years of trading, 30,000 sites hosted and hold its own mainland licences.

retention.stated: The trial is one day per product and one purchase per account, so it demonstrates the machine rather than running it; the standing constraint is the monthly invoice, and the free part of the offer is the refund window.

interface_detail: inferred from the tooling the provider documents; not probed
chaining: The CNY 1 day is enough to benchmark the mainland latency of a HK or JP node before paying for a month, which is the only cheap way to test a route without a card.

A 2019 forum post describes email plus phone verification with a CNY 10 balance for the first month.

the vendor forum states 可7天内无理由退款（每个账号限3次） and 云服务器/游戏云产品可1元试用一天（每款限1次）, quoted

notes: The CNY 15/month floor is taken from the storefront mirror because the main site renders prices in script; the figure is quoted as written and not converted. The one-yuan trial limits are three refunds per account and one trial per product, quoted from the vendor forum.
